sections.title: Prerequisite Review: From Arrows to Objects
lecture_lines: Objects treated as points in space.
animations: Fade in 'Objects' text (#FFFFFF) at center position.
Create arrow between points A and B, color #FF00FF.
Label the arrow 'Morphism' with text color #FFFF00.

sections.title: Defining the Arena: The 8 Axioms
lecture_lines: A vector space has two operations.
Addition and scalar multiplication must apply.
animations: Display the 8 axioms in a list, color #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stadium.svg]
Highlight the first 4 axioms using color #FF0000.
Highlight the last 4 axioms using color #00FF00. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scoreboard.svg]

sections.title: Visualizing Abstract Spaces
lecture_lines: A robot's position is a vector.
animations: Draw a 3D grid representing abstract space, color #FFFFFF.
Rotate the 3D grid slowly to reveal depth, color #FFFFFF.
Flash the origin point using color #FF00FF and introduce the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] at the center.

sections.title: Concrete Application: Sound Synthesis
lecture_lines: Bird songs combine as frequency vectors.
Audio engineering uses this linear combination.
animations: Animate a sine wave moving on screen, color #00FFFF, with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bird.svg] flying along the wave path.
Display the formula 'y = A sin(wt)' in color #FFFF00.
Show wave amplitude changing dynamically, color #FF0000, accompanied by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bird.svg] reacting to the height changes.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Abstract spaces offer a universal language.
Tools apply from AI to quantum.
animations: Display the text 'Summary' centrally in color #FFFFFF alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ai.svg].
Collapse previous visual elements toward the center, color #FFFFFF.
Fade screen to solid background color #000000 including [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/quantum.svg].
